sources.title: Shar's Umbrae
markers: | description = While [[obscured]], the wearer has {{Advantage}} on [[Stealth|Stealth Checks]].

summary: Clothing improves AC, stealth in darkness and Shield of Faith saves.

fields.Defence: Clothing, base AC 10 plus Dexterity modifier and a +1 AC bonus.
fields.Shar’s Umbrae: Advantage on Stealth checks while obscured.
fields.Sharran Veil: When the wearer has Shield of Faith, they gain +2 to all saves in addition to the spell’s +2 AC. Shield of Faith requires Concentration and lasts until Long Rest.
fields.Acquisition: Worn by Viconia during Daughter of Darkness.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
